+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud routine for one pull request and posts the result as a pull request comment.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+[[ $pull_request_number =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "pull request number must be numeric" >&2; exit 2; }
+for value in "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}"; do
+  [[ $value =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$ ]] || { echo "REVIEW_MODEL and REVIEW_EFFORT may hold only letters, digits and . _ : -" >&2; exit 2; }
+done
+
+# Tokens go in through stdin so they stay out of the process list on the shared runner.
+# The routine holds the request open until the review ends, for up to 30 minutes.
+status=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1920 \
+  -X POST "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" \
+  -K - <<< "header = \"Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}\"" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  --data "$(printf '{"pull_request":%s,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' "$pull_request_number" "$REVIEW_MODEL" "$REVIEW_EFFORT")") || status=000
+
+run_url="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
+case "$status" in
+  200) result=passed; message="AI review passed. Model $REVIEW_MODEL, effort $REVIEW_EFFORT." ;;
+  422) result=blocked; message="AI review found blocking issues. Read the review comments on this pull request. Model $REVIEW_MODEL, effort $REVIEW_EFFORT." ;;
+  *) result=failed; message="AI review did not run to the end. The cloud routine returned HTTP $status. Comment /rereview to try again." ;;
+esac
+
+echo "ai-review: $result (HTTP $status)"
+
+curl -sS --fail-with-body -o /dev/null \
+  -X POST "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pull_request_number/comments" \
+  -K - <<< "header = \"Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN:?}\"" \
+  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  --data "$(printf '{"body":"**ai-review: %s**\\n\\n%s\\n\\n[Workflow run](%s)"}' "$result" "$message" "$run_url")"
+
+[[ $result == passed ]]

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud routine (docs/cloud-routine.md) and waits for the review.
+# Exits 0 when the review passed, 1 on blocking findings or any routine failure.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+body=$(jq -n \
+  --argjson pull_request "$pull_request_number" \
+  --arg model "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" \
+  --arg effort "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}" \
+  '{pull_request: $pull_request, model: $model, effort: $effort}')
+response=$(mktemp)
+trap 'rm -f "$response"' EXIT
+# The token goes in through --config on stdin so it stays out of the process list.
+status=$(printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" |
+  curl --silent --show-error --config - \
+    --max-time 1860 \
+    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+    --data "$body" \
+    --output "$response" \
+    --write-out '%{http_code}' \
+    "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}")
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "Review passed." ;;
+  422) echo "Reviewer reported blocking findings." >&2; cat "$response" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "Cloud routine failed with HTTP $status." >&2; cat "$response" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+# Exit 1 is reserved for blocking findings, so a missing setting exits 2.
+for name in CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN REVIEW_MODEL REVIEW_EFFORT; do
+  [ -n "${!name:-}" ] || { echo "$name is not set" >&2; exit 2; }

+body=$(jq -n \
+  --argjson pull_request "$pull_request_number" \
+  --arg model "$REVIEW_MODEL" \
+  --arg effort "$REVIEW_EFFORT" \
+  '{pull_request: $pull_request, model: $model, effort: $effort}')
+response=$(mktemp)
+trap 'rm -f "$response"' EXIT
+# The routine holds the request open until the review finishes, up to 30 minutes.
+status=$(curl -sS -o "$response" -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+  -X POST "$CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  --data "$body") || { echo "request to cloud routine failed" >&2; exit 2; }
+cat "$response"
+echo
+case "$status" in
+  200) ;;
+  422) echo "reviewer reported blocking findings" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "cloud routine failed with HTTP $status" >&2; exit 2 ;;

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/fire_routine.sh against a stub curl and checks the exit code for each HTTP status.
+set -uo pipefail
+here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
+stub=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$stub"' EXIT
+cat > "$stub/curl" <<'EOF'
+#!/bin/bash
+out=
+data=
+while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    -o) out=$2; shift ;;
+    --data) data=$2; shift ;;
+  esac
+  shift
+done
+printf '%s' "$data" > "$STUB_DIR/body"
+echo '{"ok":true}' > "$out"
+[ "$STUB_STATUS" = "000" ] && exit 7
+printf '%s' "$STUB_STATUS"
+EOF
+chmod +x "$stub/curl"
+export PATH="$stub:$PATH" STUB_DIR="$stub"
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=https://routine.invalid CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=t REVIEW_MODEL=m REVIEW_EFFORT=high
+failures=0
+for case in 200:0 422:1 500:2 000:2; do
+  STUB_STATUS=${case%%:*} "$here/fire_routine.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+  got=$?
+  want=${case##*:}
+  if [ "$got" = "$want" ]; then echo "ok   HTTP ${case%%:*} -> exit $got"; else echo "FAIL HTTP ${case%%:*} -> exit $got, want $want"; failures=1; fi
+done
+REVIEW_MODEL='' STUB_STATUS=200 "$here/fire_routine.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+got=$?
+if [ "$got" = 2 ]; then echo "ok   missing setting -> exit 2"; else echo "FAIL missing setting -> exit $got, want 2"; failures=1; fi
+STUB_STATUS=200 "$here/fire_routine.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+if jq -e '.pull_request == 42 and .model == "m" and .effort == "high"' "$stub/body" > /dev/null; then
+  echo "ok   request body"
+else
+  echo "FAIL request body: $(cat "$stub/body")"; failures=1
+fi
+exit $failures

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/start_review.sh against a local stub of the cloud routine.
+set -euo pipefail
+cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$stub_pid" 2>/dev/null; rm -r "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$work/stub.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, sys
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))
+        with open(sys.argv[2], "w") as f:
+            json.dump({"auth": self.headers["Authorization"], "body": body}, f)
+        self.send_response(int(self.path.strip("/")))
+        self.end_headers()
+    def log_message(self, *a): pass
+server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+with open(sys.argv[1], "w") as f:
+    f.write(str(server.server_port))
+server.serve_forever()
+EOF
+python3 "$work/stub.py" "$work/port" "$work/request.json" &
+stub_pid=$!
+until [ -s "$work/port" ]; do sleep 0.1; done
+port=$(cat "$work/port")
+
+export REVIEW_MODEL=m1 REVIEW_EFFORT=high CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=tok
+fails=0
+expect() { # status, expected exit code
+  CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$port/$1" scripts/start_review.sh 42 >/dev/null 2>&1 && got=0 || got=$?
+  if [ "$got" = "$2" ]; then echo "ok   HTTP $1 -> exit $got"; else echo "FAIL HTTP $1 -> exit $got, want $2"; fails=1; fi
+}
+expect 200 0
+want='{"auth":"Bearer tok","body":{"pull_request":42,"model":"m1","effort":"high"}}'
+if [ "$(jq -c . "$work/request.json")" = "$want" ]; then echo "ok   request body and token"; else echo "FAIL request: $(cat "$work/request.json")"; fails=1; fi
+expect 422 1
+expect 500 1
+CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:1/200" scripts/start_review.sh 42 >/dev/null 2>&1 && got=0 || got=$?
+if [ "$got" = 1 ]; then echo "ok   unreachable -> exit 1"; else echo "FAIL unreachable -> exit $got"; fails=1; fi
+exit "$fails"

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud routine (docs/cloud-routine.md) and waits for the review.
+# Exits 0 when the review passed, 1 on blocking findings or a routine failure.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+model=${REVIEW_MODEL:?}
+effort=${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}
+url=${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}
+token=${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}
+
+if [[ ! $pull_request_number =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+  echo "pull request number must be numeric: $pull_request_number" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+for value in "$model" "$effort"; do
+  if [[ $value == *[\"\\]* ]]; then
+    echo "REVIEW_MODEL and REVIEW_EFFORT must not contain quotes or backslashes" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+done
+body=$(printf '{"pull_request":%s,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' "$pull_request_number" "$model" "$effort")
+
+response=$(mktemp)
+trap 'rm -f -- "$response"' EXIT
+
+# The routine holds the request open for up to 30 minutes.
+# The token goes in on stdin so it stays out of the process list.
+status=$(printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "$token" | curl -sS \
+  --max-time 1900 \
+  -X POST \
+  -H @- \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+  --data "$body" \
+  -o "$response" \
+  -w '%{http_code}' \
+  "$url") || {
+  echo "cloud routine request failed (curl exit $?)" >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "review passed" ;;
+  422) echo "reviewer reported blocking findings" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "cloud routine failed with HTTP $status:" >&2; cat "$response" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/start_cloud_review.sh against a local stub of the cloud routine.
+# Usage: tests/test_start_cloud_review.sh
+set -uo pipefail
+repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; rm -r -- "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$work/stub.py" <<'PY'
+import http.server, json, sys
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))
+        ok = (self.headers.get("Authorization") == "Bearer t0ken"
+              and self.headers.get("Content-Type") == "application/json"
+              and body == {"pull_request": 42, "model": "m-1", "effort": "high"})
+        code = int(self.path.strip("/")) if ok else 400
+        self.send_response(code); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b"stub body")
+    def log_message(self, *a): pass
+s = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+print(s.server_port, flush=True)
+s.serve_forever()
+PY
+python3 -I "$work/stub.py" > "$work/port" &
+server_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do [ -s "$work/port" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+port=$(cat "$work/port")
+
+fail=0
+check() { # name expected_exit status_path [extra env...]
+  local name=$1 want=$2 path=$3; shift 3
+  env REVIEW_MODEL=m-1 REVIEW_EFFORT=high CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=t0ken \
+    CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$port/$path" "$@" \
+    "$repo/scripts/start_cloud_review.sh" 42 > "$work/out" 2>&1
+  local got=$?
+  if [ "$got" -eq "$want" ]; then echo "PASS $name"; else echo "FAIL $name: exit $got, want $want"; sed 's/^/  | /' "$work/out"; fail=1; fi
+  if grep -q t0ken "$work/out"; then echo "FAIL $name: token leaked to output"; fail=1; fi
+}
+check "200 passes" 0 200
+check "422 fails" 1 422
+check "500 fails" 1 500
+check "bad request shape fails" 1 200 REVIEW_EFFORT=low
+check "unreachable routine fails" 1 200 CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1/200
+check "missing token fails" 1 200 CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=
+check "quote in model rejected" 1 200 'REVIEW_MODEL=m"1'
+exit $fail

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud routine (docs/cloud-routine.md) and waits for the review.
+# Exits 0 when the review passed and non-zero otherwise.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+body=$(printf '{"pull_request":%d,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' \
+  "$pull_request_number" "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}")

+status=$(printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" |
+  curl --silent --show-error --max-time 1860 \

+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  --data "$body")
+cat "$response_file"

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+run_url="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
+response=$(mktemp)
+trap 'rm -f "$response"' EXIT
+
+# The routine holds the POST open until the review ends, up to 30 minutes.
+status=$(curl -sS -o "$response" -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+  -X POST "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  -d "{\"pull_request\": $pull_request_number, \"model\": \"${REVIEW_MODEL:?}\", \"effort\": \"${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}\"}") || true
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) result="passed"; message="AI review passed." ;;
+  422) result="blocking"; message="AI review found blocking issues. See the review comments." ;;
+  *) result="failed"; message="The cloud routine failed (HTTP status: ${status:-none}). Comment /rereview to try again." ;;
+esac
+
+curl -sSf -o /dev/null \
+  -X POST "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pull_request_number/comments" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
+  -d "{\"body\": \"**ai-review: $result.** $message [Run]($run_url)\"}"
+
+[ "$result" = passed ]

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/cloud_review.sh against a local mock of the cloud routine and the GitHub API.
+set -euo pipefail
+cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$server" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$work/mock.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, os, sys
+work = sys.argv[1]
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
+        if self.path == "/routine":
+            json.loads(body)
+            with open(os.path.join(work, "routine_body"), "wb") as f: f.write(body)
+            code = int(open(os.path.join(work, "routine_status")).read())
+        else:
+            with open(os.path.join(work, "comment"), "wb") as f: f.write(body)
+            with open(os.path.join(work, "comment_path"), "w") as f: f.write(self.path)
+            code = 201
+        self.send_response(code); self.end_headers()
+    def log_message(self, *a): pass
+http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8787), H).serve_forever()
+EOF
+python3 "$work/mock.py" "$work" &
+server=$!
+sleep 1
+
+export GITHUB_SERVER_URL=https://github.com GITHUB_REPOSITORY=o/r GITHUB_RUN_ID=9
+export GITHUB_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787/api
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787/routine CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=t
+export REVIEW_MODEL=m REVIEW_EFFORT=high GH_TOKEN=g
+
+failures=0
+check() {
+  local routine_status=$1 want_exit=$2 want_text=$3
+  echo "$routine_status" > "$work/routine_status"
+  rm -f "$work/comment"
+  local got_exit=0
+  scripts/cloud_review.sh 42 || got_exit=$?
+  if [ "$got_exit" = "$want_exit" ] && grep -q "$want_text" "$work/comment" \
+    && grep -q '"pull_request": 42' "$work/routine_body" \
+    && [ "$(cat "$work/comment_path")" = /api/repos/o/r/issues/42/comments ]; then
+    echo "PASS routine $routine_status"
+  else
+    echo "FAIL routine $routine_status: exit $got_exit, comment: $(cat "$work/comment" 2>/dev/null)"
+    failures=$((failures + 1))
+  fi
+}
+check 200 0 "ai-review: passed"
+check 422 1 "ai-review: blocking"
+check 500 1 "ai-review: failed.*HTTP status: 500"
+
+if grep -rq "check-runs\|ai-review.*check_run" .github scripts; then
+  echo "FAIL a workflow or script still writes the ai-review check run"; failures=$((failures + 1))
+fi
+if grep -q "desktop" .github/workflows/*.yml; then
+  echo "FAIL a workflow still runs on the desktop runner"; failures=$((failures + 1))
+fi
+exit "$failures"
